name: Poultry Houses

end_product.name: commercial poultry house
end_product.description: A long, enclosed, ventilated building used to raise chickens or turkeys commercially. Includes broiler, breeder, pullet, layer, and turkey houses.
not_included: Backyard, hobby, or mobile chicken coops.
General agricultural buildings (pole barns, equestrian barns, dairy or hog barns, machine sheds, storage) unless the company shows it builds poultry houses.

our_products.summary: aluminum-framed, fiberglass-paneled doors and vinyl windows for poultry houses

notes: Makers of agricultural doors or windows that can be used in poultry houses (for example walk-in doors) are IN under rule C, even if they are not marketed only for poultry.
Large equipment makers that offer poultry house doors among many other products are IN under rule C.

Makers of other poultry house equipment (feeders, drinkers, fans, heaters, lighting, controllers, cooling pads, curtains, inlets) are OUT unless they also build houses, distribute house equipment, or make doors or windows.
Poultry supply stores and poultry equipment dealers are IN under rule B.
General building-materials distributors and lumber yards are OUT unless they show a poultry or agricultural program.
Poultry growers and integrators that own or operate poultry houses are OUT.
Feed, animal health, hatcheries, processing plants, egg brands, staffing, and the sale, financing, or insurance of poultry farms are OUT.
